title: Taipei Times — 'N Korea says its status as nuclear state irreversible'
snippet: North Korea said Sunday its status as a nuclear weapons state was irreversible and key to ensuring regional stability, rejecting calls by the United States and its allies for denuclearisation. AFP/Taipei Times coverage of the DPRK foreign ministry statement.
